integrity: Analytic all-size spectral and transport proof; exact finite graph replays are supplemental, not a substitute for the proof. No independent audit or external validation has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Applies to two identical hard-core bosons with unit hopping on unweighted K_{p,q}, p,q>=3. Neither distinguishable-particle, Grover-walk, dissipation, nor thermodynamic claims are made. Adjacency-frequency collisions use additive multiplicity. Earlier equivalent unindexed sources cannot be excluded.
title: Flat-band confinement and collective pair transfer for hard-core bosons on complete bipartite networks
